What's an example of where replaceStr can be replaced with index, that isn't already the $index replaced below?

from what i have seen so far it is some kind of workaround to still expose buggy configs that duplicate a name of an already exposed config.

Author: James Feist <james.feist@linux.intel.com>
Date:   Mon Mar 16 14:02:27 2020 -0700

    EM: On duplicates use device index
    
    For some platforms the PSU have the same address
    but a different bus. To fix this, change the duplicate
    names over to using index.
    
    Tested: EM had no duplicate PSU numbers
    
    Change-Id: Ibf9c7fe1b75a6420c858de194346433781d8f389

So it appears that it is not `$index` which is replaced, at least that does not seem to have been the intent.
Thanks to @yang.chen@quantatw.com for the detailed logs back then 👍
